title: CloudCam AI Internet Identity-only auth flow, protected routes, profile bootstrapping, and branding fixes

requirements.summary: Ensure Internet Identity is the only sign-up/login method and all UI copy reflects passwordless Internet Identity authentication (no username/password UI).
acceptanceCriteria: There is no username/password registration or login API added to the backend canister.
All user-facing authentication text refers to Internet Identity (passwordless) and does not mention creating a CloudCam AI password.

file_operations.description: Audit and update authentication-related copy to consistently describe Internet Identity as the only (passwordless) sign-in method; ensure no strings imply a CloudCam AI password or custom credentials. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update header auth CTA labels/copy (e.g., logged-out 'Sign In') to explicitly reference Internet Identity and avoid any password/username implication. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update account/authentication terms copy so it references CloudCam AI + Internet Identity login (passwordless) where applicable and does not suggest CloudCam AI password accounts. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Make the /login route the entry point for authentication and enforce redirects to /login for unauthenticated access to protected routes (/dashboard and /camera), with post-login redirect to /dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: When not authenticated, navigating to /dashboard redirects to /login.
When not authenticated, navigating to /camera redirects to /login.
After successful Internet Identity login, the user is redirected to /dashboard.

file_operations.description: Verify and harden route protection for /dashboard and /camera using router guards, ensuring unauthenticated navigation reliably redirects to /login (including direct URL entry/refresh). Keep the existing Internet Identity-based auth context approach. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Confirm post-login navigation always routes authenticated users to /dashboard (and does not leave users on /login). Ensure errors are handled without breaking redirect behavior. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: On first authenticated use, trigger backend profile auto-creation via the existing getCallerUserProfile flow and consistently load the persisted profile for the principal on subsequent visits/reloads.
acceptanceCriteria: After logging in with Internet Identity and visiting the dashboard, a caller profile exists in the backend (auto-created if missing).
Refreshing the dashboard continues to load the same persisted profile data for that principal (createdAt remains stable across reloads).

file_operations.description: Adjust the current-user profile query to align with the authorization component’s frontend guidance: only run getCallerUserProfile when the actor is ready and the user is authenticated; keep a stable query key and ensure loading state prevents UI flash. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the dashboard reliably triggers the caller profile load (which auto-creates if missing) and renders sensible states for loading/authorization errors, while continuing to display persisted profile fields across refreshes. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Confirm logout clears cached application data (including the cached user profile) per the authorization component guidance (retain/ensure queryClient.clear + navigation behavior). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Update UI branding to consistently use “CloudCam AI” everywhere, including the HTML document title.
acceptanceCriteria: The browser tab title uses “CloudCam AI” (not “CloutChem AI”).
No visible UI strings show the old product name.

file_operations.description: Update the HTML document title to “CloudCam AI” to fix the browser tab title branding. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Replace remaining visible occurrences of the old product name with “CloudCam AI” throughout the Terms UI text. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Audit and update any remaining visible branding strings to “CloudCam AI” (ensure no old-name text is rendered in headings, descriptions, CTAs). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Audit and update any remaining visible branding strings to “CloudCam AI” (ensure no old-name text is rendered). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
